stem.text: Which spring combination has an overall spring constant of $8.0\,\text{N m}^{-1}$?

A.alt: Two springs one below the other hanging from a grey support. Each spring is labelled extension = 0.20 m, and a downward arrow at the bottom is labelled 1.6 N.

B.alt: Two springs side by side between a grey support and a horizontal bar, each labelled extension = 0.075 m. A downward arrow below a lower horizontal bar is labelled 1.2 N.

C.alt: Two springs side by side between a grey support and a horizontal bar, each labelled extension = 0.075 m. A single spring below a lower horizontal bar is labelled extension = 0.15 m, and a downward arrow is labelled 1.8 N.

D.alt: Two columns of two springs each, between a grey support and a horizontal bar, every spring labelled extension = 0.075 m. A downward arrow below a lower horizontal bar is labelled 2.4 N.
